# Motion Interaction

Interactive micro-animations from the Motion Gallery: ripple, magnetic and squish buttons built on native Universal Theme buttons, a 3D tilt card, a cursor spotlight panel and a like toggle.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_MOTION_INTERACTION` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/motionInteraction` |
| Modes | partial (single / report column) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.1 |
| Based on | [Motion Gallery](https://github.com/MoatasemKamal/oracle-apex-components-library/blob/main/motion-gallery/index.html) (Original) |

Buttons and cards navigate to Link URL when it is set. The like toggle fires the custom event amc-like-change with detail.liked and detail.value; catch it with a Dynamic Action to save the choice.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `effect` | Effect | selectList (`ripple`, `magnetic`, `squish`, `tilt`, `spotlight`, `like`) | yes | `ripple` | The interaction. |
| `label` | Label | sessionStateValue | yes |  | Button label, card or panel title, or the accessible name of the like toggle. |
| `text` | Text | sessionStateValue |  |  | Tilt card and spotlight: supporting text. Like toggle: a value passed in the amc-like-change event, for example the record ID. |
| `linkUrl` | Link URL | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional target for buttons, tilt card and spotlight, for example from apex_page.get_url. Must be developer-controlled. |
| `liked` | Liked | sessionStateValue |  |  | Like toggle only: Y to show it as liked, for example from a column. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/motion-interaction/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_motion_interaction.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
